site_description: A public library of recorded Buddhist teachings, each sealed by its contents and kept on the Swarm network.
hero_lead: Recorded Buddhist teachings, sealed by their contents and kept on Swarm.
list_search_placeholder: A title, a teacher, a phrase
list_empty_body: Try another word, or clear the filters.
list_caption: Newest teaching first. Every one here was approved by its keepers before it was shared.
teaser_title: Change a word, the fingerprint changes.
teaser_lead: Every file here has a fingerprint taken from its exact contents. Edit the line and watch it.
teaser_differs: Does not match: the change shows
detail_media_note: Streamed from the Swarm network. Long recordings can take a moment to start.
detail_no_media: No recording is kept for this teaching.
detail_no_transcript: No text is kept for this teaching.
check_intro: Your browser fetches the file from Swarm and takes its fingerprint itself. No server of ours is involved.
check_verified: Verified. This copy matches the fingerprint recorded when it was sealed.
check_mismatch: Does not match. This copy differs from the one that was sealed.
check_fetch_failed: Could not fetch the file from the Swarm gateway. Try again, or check it yourself with the fingerprint below.
check_large: This recording is {size}. Checking it downloads the whole file and may be slow on a phone or a metered connection.
check_self: To check by hand: download the file, then run sha256sum on it and compare.
panel_paid_for_help: Swarm storage is prepaid rent. MetaProvide buys the postage batch and its top-ups; centres and teachers pay nothing.
panel_resolves_help: A gateway reassembles the pieces from the Swarm network. If you run your own Bee node you can resolve the same reference directly.
how_lead: Four things happen between a voice in a room and a copy you can trust.
how_step_recorded_body: A teaching is gathered with its audio, its transcript and the facts of when and where it was given.
how_step_sealed_body: The exact contents produce one fingerprint. Change a single word and the fingerprint is entirely different.
how_step_spread_body: Swarm cuts the collection into small chunks and keeps them on independent machines around the world, so no single fire, flood or company holds the only copy.
how_step_found_body: Anyone with the reference can gather the chunks back and confirm, in their own browser, that nothing changed.
how_fig_recorded: A teaching gathered into one collection: audio, transcript and its record.
how_fig_sealed: The collection sealed with a fingerprint taken from its contents.
how_fig_spread: Chunks of the collection held on many separate computers.
how_fig_found: The chunks gathered back and the fingerprint checked.
how_why_body: Nalanda’s library burned in the twelfth century. Between 1966 and 1976 the monastery libraries of Tibet were destroyed, and much of what survives was carried into exile by hand. The people who keep these texts today, in Dharamsala and elsewhere, worry about the next fifty years.
about_lead: The Dharma Commons shares recorded teachings so they can be found, cited and checked beyond any one organisation.
about_evident_body: Because a teaching’s address comes from its contents, nobody can change it in place. A correction is simply a new address, and the old one still points at the old copy.
about_rent_body: Swarm storage is paid for in advance with postage batches that run down and must be topped up. A teaching stays available while its storage is funded. We will not promise permanence.
about_privacy_body: Only published teachings and their records are kept here. Registrations, attendance and anything that identifies a living participant are never stored on Swarm.
about_review_body: Each teaching is packaged, checked and approved by the people responsible for it, with its rights recorded, before it appears in this library.
contribute_lead: For teachers and centres with recordings and transcripts worth keeping for the next generation.
contribute_what_body: The recording, any transcript, when and where it was taught, who holds the rights, and written permission to publish it.
contribute_how_body: We package the teaching, you check the record, and once you approve it the collection is sealed, stored on Swarm and listed here.
contribute_cost_body: Nothing. MetaProvide pays for the storage.
notfound_title: Nothing is kept at this address.
notfound_body: The page may have moved. The teachings are all in one place.
intro_step_recorded: One teaching, gathered as files such as {file}.
intro_step_sealed: Its exact bytes give it a fingerprint.
intro_step_spread: Cut into chunks, held on many computers.
intro_step_found: Gathered back and checked in your browser.
